style.name: New Wave Typography
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: New Wave Typography for global-news posters, using energetic diagonal type, layered text bands, asymmetric grids, torn-paper geometry and sharp black, cream, cobalt and signal-red contrasts. Facts, data and information graphics dominate; Xiazi and Doudou stay small at the edges.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 八个信号把关税、AI、隐私、机器人、健康、气候与太空推上同一张经营图
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者要把合规、内容可信度、员工安全和供应链韧性并入同一套预案
zh-CN.headlineFull: 八个信号把关税、AI、隐私、机器人、健康、气候与太空推上同一张经营图；经营者要把合规、内容可信度、员工安全和供应链韧性并入同一套预案
zh-CN.intro: 加美汽车关税、AI监管、创作者型小企业与TikTok儿童隐私和解构成今天的经营主线；机器人百米突破、芽菜疫情、欧洲热浪和Swift卫星任务变化补齐技术、健康、气候与太空风险面。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 热点真正进入经营，往往会同时改变成本、责任、信任或交付边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把八个信号放在一页，再圈出今天必须行动的两项。

en-US.headlineFact: Eight signals put tariffs, AI, privacy, robots, health, climate and space on one operating map
en-US.headlineView: operators need one plan connecting compliance, content trust, staff safety and supply-chain resilience
en-US.headlineFull: Eight signals put tariffs, AI, privacy, robots, health, climate and space on one operating map; operators need one plan connecting compliance, content trust, staff safety and supply-chain resilience
en-US.intro: Canada auto duties, AI rules, creator-led small business and a TikTok child-privacy settlement lead today's operating signals; a robot sprint record, a sprouts outbreak, Europe's heat and the Swift mission change complete the technology, health, climate and space picture.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A headline enters operations when it changes cost, responsibility, trust or delivery boundaries.
en-US.doudouQuote: Put the eight signals on one page, then circle the two actions due today.

sources.title: Additional duties on Canadian motor vehicles

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国对部分加拿大汽车产品加征50%额外关税的措施已于8月19日生效
zh-CN.headlineView: 跨境经营者应立即重算原产地、到岸成本、合同责任与替代供应路线
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国对部分加拿大汽车产品加征50%额外关税的措施已于8月19日生效；跨境经营者应立即重算原产地、到岸成本、合同责任与替代供应路线
zh-CN.intro: 新措施把关税冲击从政策公告推入清关与交付环节；卖家、零部件供应商和物流服务商应按入境时间核对适用税率、USMCA资格、报价有效期、库存位置和客户沟通。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 关税不是财务表最后一行，它会重写报价、库存和承诺交期。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先按入境日把订单分组，再决定改价、改仓还是改路线。

en-US.headlineFact: A 50 percent additional US duty on certain Canadian motor-vehicle products took effect August 19
en-US.headlineView: cross-border operators should recalculate origin, landed cost, contract exposure and alternate supply routes now
en-US.headlineFull: A 50 percent additional US duty on certain Canadian motor-vehicle products took effect August 19; cross-border operators should recalculate origin, landed cost, contract exposure and alternate supply routes now
en-US.intro: The measure moves tariff risk from announcement into customs clearance and delivery; sellers, parts suppliers and logistics providers should check entry dates, USMCA status, quote validity, inventory location and customer communication.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A tariff is not the last line of a finance sheet; it rewrites quotes, inventory and promised delivery.
en-US.doudouQuote: Group orders by entry date before changing price, warehouse or route.

sources.title: Imposing additional duties on Canadian motor vehicles

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI法案新的透明度规则已进入执法阶段
zh-CN.headlineView: 面向欧盟用户的团队应把模型说明、合成内容标识和责任人变成可审计记录
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI法案新的透明度规则已进入执法阶段；面向欧盟用户的团队应把模型说明、合成内容标识和责任人变成可审计记录
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟委员会表示，AI办公室与各国主管机关已开始执行相关规则；产品团队应盘点模型来源、风险分类、用户告知、深度合成标记、人工复核和事件处理证据。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 透明不是在页脚加一句话，而是让每个关键决定都有证据可追。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先列出模型、数据、用途和负责人四张表。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: New EU AI Act transparency rules have entered the enforcement phase
en-US.headlineView: teams serving EU users should turn model notes, synthetic-content labels and ownership into auditable records
en-US.headlineFull: New EU AI Act transparency rules have entered the enforcement phase; teams serving EU users should turn model notes, synthetic-content labels and ownership into auditable records
en-US.intro: The European Commission says the AI Office and national authorities have begun enforcement; product teams should inventory model origin, risk class, user notices, deepfake labels, human review and incident evidence.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transparency is not one sentence in a footer; every critical decision needs a traceable record.
en-US.doudouQuote: Start with four lists: models, data, use cases and owners.

sources.title: Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and transparency requirements

zh-CN.headlineFact: 一项五国调查显示小企业正主动把自己变成内容创作者
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司要用AI缩短制作时间，但用真实经验和可验证结果建立信任
zh-CN.headlineFull: 一项五国调查显示小企业正主动把自己变成内容创作者；一人公司要用AI缩短制作时间，但用真实经验和可验证结果建立信任
zh-CN.intro: 覆盖美国、英国、加拿大、澳大利亚和新西兰的调查显示，小企业越来越依靠内容获得注意，内置AI工具可缩短部分营销与邮件制作时间；经营者仍需跟踪线索、转化和复购。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 内容不是额外工作，而是把经营证据送到潜在客户面前。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 省下的时间要回到客户访谈、案例和成交复盘。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: A five-country survey shows small businesses actively becoming content creators
en-US.headlineView: solo companies should use AI to shorten production while building trust with real experience and measurable results
en-US.headlineFull: A five-country survey shows small businesses actively becoming content creators; solo companies should use AI to shorten production while building trust with real experience and measurable results
en-US.intro: A survey across the US, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand says small businesses increasingly use content to get noticed, while built-in AI can reduce some campaign and email creation time; operators should still track leads, conversion and repeat business.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Content is not extra work; it carries operating proof to potential customers.
en-US.doudouQuote: Return saved time to customer interviews, cases and sales review.

sources.title: Small businesses embrace the role of creator to get seen in 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国司法部宣布TikTok与字节跳动以4亿美元和解儿童隐私诉讼
zh-CN.headlineView: 面向未成年人的产品必须把年龄识别、数据最小化和家长控制做成默认能力
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国司法部宣布TikTok与字节跳动以4亿美元和解儿童隐私诉讼；面向未成年人的产品必须把年龄识别、数据最小化和家长控制做成默认能力
zh-CN.intro: 和解再次把儿童数据收集、告知、同意与删除机制推到平台责任中心；产品和营销团队应检查默认设置、画像范围、广告投放、保留期限和申诉路径。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 儿童隐私不能靠用户主动找开关，保护必须从默认状态开始。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先删掉不必要的数据，再讨论更复杂的合规流程。

en-US.headlineFact: The US Justice Department announced a $400 million TikTok and ByteDance child-privacy settlement
en-US.headlineView: products serving minors need age assurance, data minimization and parental controls by default
en-US.headlineFull: The US Justice Department announced a $400 million TikTok and ByteDance child-privacy settlement; products serving minors need age assurance, data minimization and parental controls by default
en-US.intro: The settlement puts children's data collection, notice, consent and deletion back at the center of platform responsibility; product and marketing teams should review defaults, profiling, ads, retention and appeals.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Children's privacy cannot depend on users finding a switch; protection starts with defaults.
en-US.doudouQuote: Delete unnecessary data before designing a more complex compliance flow.

sources.title: Justice Department secures $400M TikTok and ByteDance settlement

zh-CN.headlineFact: 中国人形机器人在北京赛事中跑出超越人类百米世界纪录的计时
zh-CN.headlineView: 高速运动能力正在把机器人竞争从演示视频推向动力、控制与可靠性的公开测试
zh-CN.headlineFull: 中国人形机器人在北京赛事中跑出超越人类百米世界纪录的计时；高速运动能力正在把机器人竞争从演示视频推向动力、控制与可靠性的公开测试
zh-CN.intro: 路透社报道，一台中国机器人在百米项目中跑出快于尤塞恩·博尔特纪录的时间；行业仍需区分设备规则与人类竞赛，但电机、平衡、热管理和安全控制的进步值得关注。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 纪录是传播入口，真正的产业价值藏在连续稳定运行里。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 别只看最快一秒，也要看它能否安全地重复一百次。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人形机器人。

en-US.headlineFact: A Chinese humanoid robot posted a 100-meter time faster than the human world record at a Beijing event
en-US.headlineView: high-speed locomotion is moving robot competition from demos to public tests of power, control and reliability
en-US.headlineFull: A Chinese humanoid robot posted a 100-meter time faster than the human world record at a Beijing event; high-speed locomotion is moving robot competition from demos to public tests of power, control and reliability
en-US.intro: Reuters reported that a Chinese robot completed a 100-meter event faster than Usain Bolt's record time; machine and human rules differ, but progress in motors, balance, thermal management and safety control matters.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A record opens the story; industrial value lives in stable repeated operation.
en-US.doudouQuote: Do not watch only the fastest second; ask whether it can repeat safely one hundred times.

sources.title: Chinese robot beats Usain Bolt's 100m world record at Beijing games

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国疾控机构调查与苜蓿芽菜相关的大肠杆菌和沙门氏菌疫情
zh-CN.headlineView: 餐饮与零售商应立即核对批次、供应商、冷链记录和召回沟通
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国疾控机构调查与苜蓿芽菜相关的大肠杆菌和沙门氏菌疫情；餐饮与零售商应立即核对批次、供应商、冷链记录和召回沟通
zh-CN.intro: 多州病例把生鲜芽菜的短保质期与追溯难度再次暴露出来；经营者应隔离涉事产品、保存采购与配送记录、通知门店和客户，并同步检查交叉污染控制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 食品召回拼的不是公关速度，而是批次追溯和阻断暴露的速度。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先隔离、再追溯、再通知，三步不要颠倒。

en-US.headlineFact: US health agencies are investigating E. coli and Salmonella illnesses linked to alfalfa sprouts
en-US.headlineView: restaurants and retailers should verify lots, suppliers, cold-chain records and recall communication immediately
en-US.headlineFull: US health agencies are investigating E. coli and Salmonella illnesses linked to alfalfa sprouts; restaurants and retailers should verify lots, suppliers, cold-chain records and recall communication immediately
en-US.intro: Multistate illnesses expose the short shelf life and traceability challenge of fresh sprouts; operators should isolate affected product, preserve purchase and delivery records, notify stores and customers, and review cross-contamination controls.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A food recall is won by lot traceability and exposure control, not public-relations speed.
en-US.doudouQuote: Isolate, trace, then notify; keep the order clear.

sources.title: E. coli and Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA称2026年欧洲接连热浪正在打破纪录并造成广泛影响
zh-CN.headlineView: 企业要把高温阈值、停工规则、能源负荷和员工保护写进连续经营计划
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA称2026年欧洲接连热浪正在打破纪录并造成广泛影响；企业要把高温阈值、停工规则、能源负荷和员工保护写进连续经营计划
zh-CN.intro: 卫星与地面观测显示欧洲多地持续受极端高温影响；物流、制造、零售和旅游企业应按地区设定工作时段、补水休息、冷链冗余、设备降载和客户通知机制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 热浪不是天气备注，而是一项会同时压迫人、设备和电网的运营变量。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把温度阈值写进排班表，比临时提醒更可靠。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA says successive European heat waves in 2026 are breaking records and taking a broad toll
en-US.headlineView: companies need heat thresholds, stop-work rules, energy-load plans and worker protection in continuity playbooks
en-US.headlineFull: NASA says successive European heat waves in 2026 are breaking records and taking a broad toll; companies need heat thresholds, stop-work rules, energy-load plans and worker protection in continuity playbooks
en-US.intro: Satellite and ground observations show persistent extreme heat across Europe; logistics, manufacturing, retail and tourism operators should set regional work hours, hydration breaks, cold-chain redundancy, equipment derating and customer notices.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A heat wave is not a weather footnote; it pressures people, equipment and the grid at once.
en-US.doudouQuote: Put temperature thresholds into the roster instead of relying on last-minute reminders.

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA与Katalyst取消为Swift天文台抬升轨道的商业航天尝试
zh-CN.headlineView: 高风险救援任务的终止凸显姿态控制、接口验证和退役预案的重要性
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA与Katalyst取消为Swift天文台抬升轨道的商业航天尝试；高风险救援任务的终止凸显姿态控制、接口验证和退役预案的重要性
zh-CN.intro: 由于LINK航天器持续存在姿态控制问题，原计划捕获并抬升Swift的任务不再执行；这台服役21年的天文台可能在年内再入大气层，团队将转向安全退役与科学数据收尾。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 创新任务允许失败，但接口、边界和退出条件必须在起飞前写清楚。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 救援计划结束时，安全退役就是下一项正式任务。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA and Katalyst ended the commercial attempt to boost the Swift observatory's orbit
en-US.headlineView: the end of a high-risk rescue mission underscores attitude control, interface verification and disposal planning
en-US.headlineFull: NASA and Katalyst ended the commercial attempt to boost the Swift observatory's orbit; the end of a high-risk rescue mission underscores attitude control, interface verification and disposal planning
en-US.intro: An ongoing attitude-control issue with the LINK spacecraft ended the planned capture and boost of Swift; the 21-year-old observatory may reenter later this year as teams shift to safe disposal and final science operations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: An innovative mission may fail, but interfaces, boundaries and exit conditions must be clear before launch.
en-US.doudouQuote: When rescue ends, safe disposal becomes the next formal mission.

sources.title: NASA updates next steps for commercial Swift boost mission
